Item / function: Screw conveyor - moves product along the trough
Failure mode: Shaft bent or runout beyond limit
Effect of failure: Shaft rubs trough; product contamination; line stops
Recommended action: Add vibration check to monthly route; fit overload alarm

Item / function: Gearbox - transmits torque to the drive
Recommended action: Check level monthly; replace leaking seal

Effect of failure: Loss of power to the line
Recommended action: Add battery voltage check to weekly round

Item / function: Electric drive motor - powers the conveyor
Recommended action: Set a greasing interval and amount; add to PM schedule
